submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.297%) at Cr0.10Fe0.32V0.58, in the V-rich, low-Cr region near the (Fe,Cr)VO4 stoichiometry. Index 87 (Cr0.16Fe0.33V0.51) came in essentially tied at 0.295%. Adding Cr and removing V (index 145) dropped EQE to 0.061%. XRD at 74, 87, 99 and 130 showed very similar phase patterns, so the performance trend appears to follow composition rather than a phase change.
